I can't query NAS-Bench-201 from this environment, so these are priors from the benchmark's known structure, not measured interactions. The main drivers are operation strength (conv3x3 > conv1x1 > avg_pool > skip > none) and whether an edit changes the set of paths from input to output. Effects are often additive and diminish when another path already carries the signal, so a strict "higher under this condition, consistent across all three datasets" claim usually fails. I gave most claims low probabilities and raised a few where the condition plausibly makes the edit a larger real change.
